name: zclass_node_set_context_recursive
description: zClass_Node::SetContextRecursive stores a callback context, ORs the supplied flag mask into the node flags, and applies the same context and flags recursively to listB children.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zClass node/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x437e60 validates the fastcall node/context arguments, stack flag-mask argument, callbackContext store at offset 0x40, flags OR at offset 0x24, and recursion over listB children.
The native zClass extra-flag smoke verifies the flag and callback context propagate through a parent, child, and grandchild chain.
